_comment: Synthetic violation fixture for scripts/lint-comms-boundary.sh. Each agent below intentionally violates one rule from _shared/primitives/agent-comms-boundary.md. tests/lint-comms-boundary/run.sh asserts the linter catches them all.

modes.name: fake-review-emitter
modes._violates: B_FORBIDDEN_CREATE — Achilles is not the authorial writer of plans/reviews/.

modes.name: fake-brief-payload-mutator
modes._violates: B_LIFECYCLE_OUT_OF_SCOPE on debrief — chanakya is the only enumerated co-writer for debriefs; achilles authorial-writes them but here we're testing a different agent. Tested via the chanakya/fake-debrief-creator below; this row covers the symmetric tasks-class case.

modes.name: fake-debrief-creator
modes._violates: B_FORBIDDEN_CREATE — Achilles is the authorial writer of plans/debriefs/.

modes.name: spec-compliance
modes._violates: B_PASS_THROUGH_VIOLATION — argus/spec-compliance is a pass-through and must not declare writes against reviews. Mode name matches the real one because the lint registry keys on (agent, mode) pairs (see is_pass_through_agent_mode in the linter).
writes: plans/reviews/<review-id>.yaml                 # spec-compliance attempting to author a review (schema: _shared/schemas/review.md)

modes.name: fake-task-payload-mutator
modes._violates: Negative test — argus may write task back-refs (links.reviews append). This row should NOT trigger any error.
